title: Gradual Hymn (Tone 4)
content:
My sinful desires have encircled me, from my youth they have oppressed me; but You, O Savior, will come to aid me. You will protect and save me.
May the enemies of Zion be confounded by the Lord; may they be a grass which withers, which is dried up by the fire.
Glory be: Now and for ever: Every spirit lives by the grace of the Holy Spirit, and is raised up in all purity; it is mystically enlightened by the one God in three Persons.
